takes.text: Markets are trading cautiously ahead of the imminent Federal Reserve rate decision at 2:00 PM ET; I am positioning for equal-weight equity outperformance, holding safe havens like gold and Bitcoin, and shorting the Euro against a potentially hawkish Fed backdrop.

I am starting with partial, diversified risk rather than swinging at the 2 p.m. Fed event: small equity exposure, an energy momentum position, a CAD-positive USD short after the confirmed Bank of Canada hike, and a defined-risk SPY options strangle for the catalyst.

thoughts.text: Adding RSP to capitalize on the recent outperformance of equal-weight S&P 500 stocks over AI-heavy indices.
Allocating to Bitcoin as it defends the critical $80,000 support level and sees renewed ETF inflows.
Holding cash as the Chinese markets are currently closed; will re-evaluate at the open.
Going long on GLD to capture the upward momentum in gold driven by safe-haven demand.
Taking a position in USO to benefit from surging oil prices amidst rising geopolitical tensions.
Holding cash to avoid the extreme volatility expected around the FOMC rate decision in a few minutes.
Shorting the Euro as EUR/USD hovers dangerously close to key support levels ahead of the Fed.
Deploying half of the capital into SPY for diversified, steady exposure to US large caps.
Backing the heavily favored New York Knicks against the Bulls to steadily build the sports bankroll.
Staying in cash while I analyze the latest 2026 midterms polling and Polymarket odds.
I want some exposure to the AI-led equity bid, but only a starter size before the Fed decision because rates can flip the tape quickly.
Bitcoin and ether look too tied to macro risk appetite right before the Fed, so I am waiting for a cleaner entry.
China A-shares are closed right now, so I will reassess at the Shanghai open instead of entering a stale order.
Gold is softer intraday but remains a useful hedge against inflation/geopolitical stress, so I am starting small rather than chasing.
Oil/energy has the clearest near-term momentum today, so I am taking a measured USO position without overconcentrating.
The imminent Fed decision and Big Tech earnings create event volatility, so I am using a small SPY call/put structure with strictly limited premium at risk.
The Bank of Canada hike is officially confirmed and should support CAD, but the Fed is minutes away, so I am shorting USD at moderate size only.
The control book should preserve capital first, with mostly T-bill exposure plus some broad equity and the maximum allowed gold sleeve.
I do not see a strong enough edge in the listed moneylines yet, so I am saving bankroll for better-confirmed spots.
I do not have a verified open Polymarket slug with a clear edge right now, so I am holding cash.
